tasks.description: Capture a frozen modernization baseline for verification.
tasks.reason: A baseline is required before integration verification to compare migrated behavior.
tasks.requirements: Create a baseline bundle from `src/` including current behavior references, test cases, test data, and an infra-decision-table for external dependencies used in verification.

tasks.description: Migrate non-secret runtime settings from local appsettings to Azure App Configuration while preserving configuration shape.
tasks.reason: Cloud-managed configuration is required for Azure-hosted operations and consistent environment management.
tasks.requirements: Move non-secret settings from local appsettings files into Azure App Configuration with compatibility for existing IConfiguration/IOptions usage; keep secret values in secure secret stores and do not hardcode credentials.

tasks.description: Build integration tests for migrated Azure services and run post-migration verification
tasks.reason: Post-migration verification is required to validate cloud configuration behavior.
tasks.requirements: Create and run integration tests for migrated Azure service interactions using the baseline bundle and existing repository infrastructure configuration.

tasks.description: Scan dependencies for known CVEs and remediate identified vulnerabilities.
tasks.reason: Security remediation is required before Azure deployment.
tasks.requirements: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs, upgrade to minimum patched versions, document major-version upgrade risks where needed, and verify build/tests after remediation.

tasks.description: Deploy the modernized application to Azure Container Apps.
tasks.reason: The modernization target is Azure-hosted runtime delivery.
tasks.requirements: Use the repository's existing Azure configuration to deploy the application to Azure Container Apps and complete post-deployment validation.
tasks.resourceStatus: Use existing Azure resources/configuration in repository
